questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct verb: Please ___ a decision before Friday.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的动词：请在星期五之前___一个决定。
questions.explanation_learning: The natural expression is “make a decision.”
questions.explanation_translation: 自然的搭配是“make a decision”（作出决定）。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase means to stop working briefly and rest?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个短语表示暂时停止工作并休息？
questions.explanation_learning: “Take a break” is the standard expression for resting briefly.
questions.explanation_translation: “Take a break”是表示短暂休息的标准表达。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase is commonly used to say that you eat the morning meal?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个短语通常用来表示吃早饭？
questions.explanation_learning: We commonly say “have breakfast” when talking about eating the morning meal.
questions.explanation_translation: 谈到吃早饭时，英语通常使用“have breakfast”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: I ___ my homework after dinner.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：我晚饭后___作业。
questions.explanation_learning: “Do homework” is the usual verb-noun combination.
questions.explanation_translation: “Do homework”是常见的动词与名词搭配。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: She bought ___ umbrella.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：她买了一把雨伞。
questions.explanation_learning: “Umbrella” begins with a vowel sound, so the singular countable noun takes “an.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Umbrella”以元音音素开头，因此单数可数名词前用“an”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：太阳从东方升起。
questions.explanation_learning: We use “the” for the unique sun in this context.
questions.explanation_translation: 在这个语境中，太阳是独一无二的，因此使用“the”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: He studies at ___ university in Kuala Lumpur.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：他在吉隆坡的一所大学学习。
questions.explanation_learning: “University” begins with the consonant sound /juː/, so “a” is correct.
questions.explanation_translation: “University”以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，因此使用“a”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: It was ___ honest mistake.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：那是一个无心的错误。
questions.explanation_learning: The “h” in “honest” is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound.
questions.explanation_translation: “Honest”中的字母 h 不发音，因此该词以元音音素开头。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct plural form: one child, two ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的复数形式：一个孩子，两个___。
questions.explanation_learning: “Child” has the irregular plural form “children.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Child”的不规则复数形式是“children”。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase is correct in standard English?
questions.prompt_translation: 以下哪个短语符合标准英语？
questions.explanation_learning: “Advice” is uncountable in standard English; use “a piece of advice” for one item of advice.
questions.explanation_translation: 在标准英语中，“advice”是不可数名词；表示一条建议时可说“a piece of advice”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: How ___ apples do we need?
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：我们需要多少个苹果？
questions.explanation_learning: “Apples” is a plural countable noun, so the question uses “many.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Apples”是可数名词复数，因此疑问句使用“many”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：瓶子里没有多少水。
questions.explanation_learning: “Water” is uncountable here, so “much” is used in this negative sentence.
questions.explanation_translation: 这里的“water”是不可数名词，因此否定句中使用“much”。

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence follows the usual subject–verb–object order?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个句子符合常见的主语—动词—宾语语序？
questions.explanation_learning: “Mia” is the subject, “reads” is the verb, and “a book” is the object.
questions.explanation_translation: “Mia”是主语，“reads”是动词，“a book”是宾语。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word order.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词序。
questions.explanation_learning: The usual statement order is subject + verb + place phrase.
questions.explanation_translation: 常见陈述句语序是主语 + 动词 + 地点短语。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct question.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的疑问句。
questions.explanation_learning: With “does,” the main verb stays in its base form: “work.”
questions.explanation_translation: 使用“does”时，主要动词保持原形“work”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the sentence with the usual adjective position.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择形容词位置通常正确的句子。
questions.explanation_learning: In this noun phrase, the adjective “red” comes before the noun “bag.”
questions.explanation_translation: 在这个名词短语中，形容词“red”放在名词“bag”之前。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct present simple form: My brother ___ to school by bus.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的一般现在时形式：我哥哥/弟弟乘公共汽车去上学。
questions.explanation_learning: With a third-person singular subject such as “my brother,” the present simple verb takes -s or -es.
questions.explanation_translation: 主语是“my brother”这样的第三人称单数时，一般现在时动词通常加 -s 或 -es。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct negative sentence.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的否定句。
questions.explanation_learning: With “they,” use “do not/don't” followed by the base form “like.”
questions.explanation_translation: 主语是“they”时，使用“do not/don't”加动词原形“like”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct present simple sentence about a habit.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择描述习惯的正确一般现在时句子。

options.learning_text: She walks to work every day.
She walk to work every day.
She walking to work every day.

options: She walkes to work every day.
questions.explanation_learning: “Every day” describes a regular habit, and “she” takes the verb form “walks.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Every day”表示规律习惯；主语“she”对应动词形式“walks”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: We ___ dinner at home on Fridays.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：我们星期五在家吃晚饭。
questions.explanation_learning: “We” takes the base present simple form “have.”
questions.explanation_translation: 主语“We”使用一般现在时动词原形“have”。
